features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 STR

features.name: Size
features.description: medium; global size adjustments apply only once.

features.name: Type
features.description: humanoid (reptillian)

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 20 feet land and 40 feet swimming; distinct movement modes.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common and Aquan. High INT bonus options: Aboleth Aklo Draconic Elvaan Sahagin Sylvan.

features.name: Bond to the Land
features.description: Choose desert OR water terrain at creation for +2 dodge AC there.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: Hold breath 4 x CON score rounds before drowning.

features.name: Tough Scales
features.description: +1 natural armor bonus.

features.name: Jeweler’s Craft
features.description: +2 Craft/Profession checks to create metal items, including jewelry.

features.name: Slapping Tail
features.description: Primary tail natural attack 1d8 plus STR; can use for 5-foot reach attacks of opportunity.

features.name: Tripping Tail
features.description: After hitting with Slapping Tail may make free trip without provoking.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Proficient with scimitar and cutlass.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far in dim light.

features.name: Legless
features.description: Cannot use leg/foot armor or foot-slot magic items, even with polymorph. May wear two magical neck-slot items using tail. Restriction ends only on resurrection as another race.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: 60 ft darkvision plus light sensitivity.

features.name: Seasinger
features.description: +2 Perform (sing), +1 DC for language-dependent spells.

features.name: Seducer
features.description: +2 Diplomacy against attractive-eligible creatures; CHA 11+ grants charm SLA 1/day at character level.

features.name: Swordtrained
features.description: Proficient falchion, greatsword, longsword, rapier, shortsword, two-bladed sword.

features.name: Tempered
features.description: Choose water OR wind resistance 5.

features.name: Ananta Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 WIS

features.name: Ananta Heritage Benefit
features.description: Deep Magic: +2 caster checks to beat spell resistance and +2 dispel checks.

features.name: Medusa Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 CON, +2 CHA, -2 DEX

features.name: Medusa Heritage Benefit
features.description: Curse Gaze spell-like ability 3/day, CHA save DC, caster level equals class level.

features.name: Undine Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 INT

features.name: Undine Heritage Benefit
features.description: Nereid Fascination 1/day; 20-ft radius fascinates humanoids 1 round/character level; Will DC 10+half level+CHA modifier.
